tier_rationale: PHI for all 110,000 patients; supports High-criticality processes BP-01 to BP-06
assurance_required: Annual SOC 2 Type 2 (Security, Availability, Confidentiality) plus bridge letter
subservice_organizations: Hosting provider carved out; e-prescribing network carved out
exceptions_noted: 2 exceptions: 3 of 40 terminated vendor staff removed late; 1 of 25 changes lacked documented approval. Both remediated per management response
cuecs_and_company_mapping: User provisioning and removal; MFA; role assignment; audit log review; downtime procedures. Mapped to AC-2, IA-2(1), AU-6, CP-2. Company gaps: AC-2 reviews (POAM-001) and AU-6 review (POAM-006)
availability_vs_bia: Stated RTO 12 h and RPO 1 h; BIA needs RTO 2-4 h and ASC RPO 15 min: **does not meet BIA** (P05 finding 1)
incident_notification_terms: Notice within 72 hours of confirming a security incident; BAA allows 60 days for breaches
follow_up: Negotiate recovery terms and 5-business-day breach notice at the 2027 renewal; obtain carve-out assurance for hosting and e-prescribing
reviewer_and_date: Security Manager and Compliance and Privacy Officer, 2026-09-12

vendor_and_service: Managed security service provider (MSSP; SYS-08 operator)
tier_rationale: Security logs that can contain PHI fragments; privileged EDR agents on all endpoints; supports detection for every process
assurance_required: Annual SOC 2 Type 2 (Security) plus bridge letter; annual service review with detection tests
subservice_organizations: SIEM SaaS platform carved out (the MSSP relies on the platform provider's SOC 2)
exceptions_noted: 2 exceptions: high-severity alert escalation missed the 30-minute target in 2 of 40 samples; 1 analyst's access review late. Management response: staffing added
cuecs_and_company_mapping: Customer must maintain the escalation contact list, approve containment actions, define log sources, and review monthly reports. Mapped to IR-4, SI-4, AU-2. Company gaps: log sources incomplete (POAM-005, POAM-021)
availability_vs_bia: Not a recovery provider; the MSSP's own continuity plan covers the SOC (tested annually per the report)
incident_notification_terms: Contract: call within 30 minutes on high severity; BAA: breach notice within 10 days
follow_up: Request the SIEM platform provider's SOC 2; add Availability to the next MSSP report scope request; track escalation SLA monthly

tier_rationale: Identities and authentication for all systems; supports all processes
assurance_required: Annual SOC 2 Type 2 plus status history review
cuecs_and_company_mapping: Customer configures MFA, conditional access, and administrator roles. Mapped to IA-2(1), AC-2, AC-6. Company gap: phishing-resistant MFA for admins (P01 R-027)
availability_vs_bia: 99.99% monthly uptime commitment; no RTO stated
incident_notification_terms: Security incident notice per terms of service (no BAA needed: the service holds identities, not PHI)

vendor_and_service: PACS vendor (SYS-03; manages software in the company's cloud account)
tier_rationale: PHI images and reports; supports BP-07 and BP-08
assurance_required: SOC 2 Type 2 if available, otherwise a security questionnaire plus contract controls, annually
report_type_and_period: No SOC 2 report; HITRUST-style questionnaire completed 2025-11
cuecs_and_company_mapping: Company controls the account, network, backups, and access, so most controls are the company's (P04 finding 1). Vendor service accounts with domain admin rights found in P07 (R-050)
availability_vs_bia: Joint restore test not yet performed (POAM-010)
follow_up: Require a SOC 2 Type 2 or independent assessment at renewal; move support to the access broker (POAM-003)

tier_rationale: Hosts workloads and backups with PHI (encrypted, company-managed keys)
assurance_required: Annual review of the provider's SOC 2 Type 2 from its compliance portal
cuecs_and_company_mapping: Customer controls per the shared responsibility model: identity, network rules, encryption keys, logging, backups (P04). Mapped to AC-2, SC-7, SC-12, AU-2, CP-9
availability_vs_bia: Region-level availability commitments per service; company uses a second region for backups
incident_notification_terms: BAA in place; notice per BAA

tier_rationale: PHI in claims and eligibility for all patients; supports BP-10 (about $1.9 million a week)
assurance_required: Annual SOC 2 Type 2 plus contingency plan review
exceptions_noted: 1 exception: disaster recovery test not completed in the period
cuecs_and_company_mapping: Customer must reconcile claim acknowledgments and protect submitter credentials. Mapped to SI-10, IA-5
availability_vs_bia: Stated RTO 24 h, but DR test not completed: **does not support BIA confidence**; single point of failure (P01 R-012)
follow_up: Secondary clearinghouse by 2027-03-31; vendor outage runbook (P08); ask for DR test results
reviewer_and_date: Director of Revenue Cycle and Compliance and Privacy Officer, 2026-09-15

tier_rationale: Visit audio and notes for 40 providers
cuecs_and_company_mapping: Customer must obtain recording consent, review notes, and manage user access. Mapped to PT-4, AC-2
availability_vs_bia: Not critical to BIA (manual documentation is the workaround)
incident_notification_terms: Vendor standard BAA; notice within 30 days; permits de-identified data use (to be amended)
follow_up: Amend BAA (no training on company data, deletion terms); request bridge letter (P10 conditions)

tier_rationale: Referral documents with PHI; limited volume
assurance_required: Security questionnaire every 2 years; SOC 2 if available
cuecs_and_company_mapping: MFA and user management by the company
